question: Can bounded, distinct numerical searches produce source-valid fits and informative model-conditioned FA witnesses at an affordable cost?
interpretation: feasibility and conditional sensitivity only; no task hardness, biological truth, likelihood interval or global optimum claims

source.cache_authority: Current raw files stream-hashed against original manifest; frozen byte-identical bank linked by receipt to historical independent full-source checks. Not a fresh preprocessing reconstruction in this pilot

selection.method: lexicographic ijk sorting, indices floor((k+0.5)*N/16), k=0..15

domain.justification: PSD follows model interpretation; 0.003 tissue upper bound is an explicit pilot assumption tied to free-water diffusivity, not a published universal tissue bound. S0 limits and f ceiling are broad operational choices, not measured noise bounds. Any bound hit is reported; no release claim is made.

model.gradient_handling: preserve source rounded values; no normalization

search.independence: Different optimizer algorithms, parameterizations and forward-objective implementations; shared NumPy/SciPy/data remain a common dependency, not full independent scientific replication
search.ordering: voxel, protocol, free/profile point, start, algorithm; no outcome-driven ordering or retries

sensitivity.ceiling_rule: best found feasible loss across both algorithms for each voxel/protocol plus each fixed budget; not a global optimum. A finite feasible iteration-limit candidate is retained with optimizer failure separately recorded
sensitivity.justification: Prespecified operational sensitivity at squared normalized residual scales .005, .01, .02; not paper-reported cutoffs, noise estimates, statistical coverage or benchmark pass thresholds
sensitivity.fraction_view_anchor: Henriques2017 Conclusion suggests .7 as a possible high-f exclusion in its study; this is a prespecified candidate-pool sensitivity view here, not a universal physiological bound
sensitivity.fraction_view_comparison: Filter the same found-candidate pool under the same full-pool ceiling; lower-bound witness sensitivity only, not independently optimized restricted-domain extrema
sensitivity.protocol_comparison: No true interval contraction/information-gain claim from nonnested mean-loss sets or independently found lower bounds

approval: Execution requires a separate root-reviewed approval JSON binding exact contract and code SHA256; no approval is embedded here

paper_anchors.locations: Eq1/Eq8/Table1; high-b exclusion in in-vivo Methods
paper_anchors.supports: model, d_iso=.003, two initial tensor spectra, signal residual and high-b caution; NOT pilot cutoffs
effective signal fraction, plausibility not specificity, initialization/model limitations; NOT this acquisition's result
